item.title: Tesselaar KaBloom 2026: Your Complete Guide
item.description: Every autumn, as Melbourne’s city gardens begin to quiet, something extraordinary blooms in the Dandenong Ranges. The Tesselaar KaBloom Flower Festival transforms 14 acres of hillside farmland into a riot of colour, with millions of flowers creating one of Victoria’s most spectacular seasonal displays. Whether you’re a photography enthusiast, a family looking for school holiday entertainment, or simply someone who needs a break from the city, KaBloom offers a day out that engages all the senses.
